-- ALL items have equipamentoSistemaId = NULL!
-- So the drill-down ONLY works when the codigoTag in equipamentos table 
-- exactly matches the equipamentoTag in item_despesa_importado
-- Let's verify: PATROL 120 B works because it's the same in both tables

-- Now let's see which equipamentos have codigoTag that matches item_despesa_importado.equipamentoTag
SELECT e.id, e.codigoTag, i.equipamentoTag
FROM equipamentos e
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT equipamentoTag FROM item_despesa_importado WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001) i
ON e.codigoTag = i.equipamentoTag
LIMIT 20;
